name: Princesses: Sunset Jetty
description: Elsa, Anna and Moana together at golden hour, laughing in the wind. 5 s on the 4-step Wan model, so it renders in about a minute. Likeness depends on the base model — see the prompt for the visual anchors that do the work.

params.negative_prompt: still image, frozen frame, distorted faces, extra limbs, text, watermark

prompt_example: three animated-film princesses standing together at the end of a wooden jetty at golden hour, laughing and talking: Elsa with a long platinum braid in a pale ice-blue gown, Anna with auburn twin braids in a green and black travelling dress, Moana with long dark curly hair in a red-orange sarong with a shell necklace. Warm low sunlight, wind moving their hair and skirts, gentle ocean swell behind them, slow camera push-in, 3D animated feature film look, soft subsurface skin, cinematic depth of field
